title: The best!
body:
Been looking for this app for years. Easy to use, E2E (!) and a great workflow that no other to do app I’ve tried has, 5/5!

Would love be able to schedule tasks in the built in calendar for tomorrow (and maybe even further) in the mobile app in a future update ☕️
author: Brorsans bror

title: Super!
body: Used most of the other task and todo apps during many years but this is really the best for my workflow.
author: Snobba
